title: Sheep waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='52' r='16' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='15' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='63' r='14' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='67' r='15' fill='#f2f0e8'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='56' r='16' fill='#fbfaf4'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a5c66'/>
  <rect x='56' y='76' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a5c66'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='39' y='88' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2e2f38'/>
  <rect x='55' y='88' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2e2f38'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#5a5c66'/>
  <!-- wool tuft on head -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='24' r='5' fill='#fbfaf4'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='22' r='5' fill='#fbfaf4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='25' r='4' fill='#fbfaf4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='33' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#484a54' transform='rotate(-20 44 33)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='34' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#484a54' transform='rotate(20 72 34)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#101018'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='33' r='2.4' fill='#101018'/>
  <circle cx='53.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64.8' cy='32.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='41' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c9b6c2'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#7a4a5e'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#7a4a5e'/>
  <!-- raised waving arm -->
  <rect x='72' y='46' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#5a5c66' transform='rotate(30 75 56)'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='40' r='5' fill='#5a5c66'/>
  <!-- other front leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='58' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a5c66'/>
  <rect x='33' y='70' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2e2f38'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='39' r='2.2' fill='#e79a9a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='40' r='2.2' fill='#e79a9a'/>
</svg>
